reality.a:
Watches and Wonders is **the most**
**competitive week** in watchmaking.
reality.label: THE REALITY
reality.b:
It’s also the **hardest** time of year
to break away from industry conventions.

why.label: WHY
why.p1: Big maisons are constrained by their own heritage. For a maison that has been here for 150 years, every bold move gets sanded down by committees, heritage managers and the sheer gravity of the codes they have spent a century building. The result: impeccable and polished.
why.p2: At the other end, younger independent brands enter the Carre des Horlogers: the right crowd, the right context, but a format that flattens everyone into the same grid. No room to breathe, no narrative space.

opp.label: THE OPPORTUNITY
opp.a:
Between the giants locked in their legacy and the independents swallowed by the format, there is
**a place to take.**
opp.b:
AND IT IS **OUT**
OF WATCHES AND WONDERS.

chal.label: THE CHALLENGE
chal.a: But getting out of WW is not enough. You need **a reason that pulls people across the city**.
chal.b:
We are here to help you create
the **“worth it” factor**.

c1.title:
MYSTICAL
MALLORCA
c1.promise: House of Wunder brings a sense of sophisticated wildness and spirituality into the the highly codified world of watchmaking.
narr: **Experience the free spirit of Mallorca in Geneva.**

Escape the rush and grey skies of Geneva. Feel the wind in your hair, the sun on your skin. Step into a world where nature’s raw energy meets effortless sophistication, and laid-back days under the sun turn into glamorous evenings that seem to last forever.
c1.scen: Each island presents a product, accompanied by either a stone or a local art or craft object that inspires the brand. The island becomes a transportable unit, which can be deployed in another event.

c2.title: THE FLOW
c2.promise: House of Wunder reimagines the traditional showroom experience, creating a unique sensory journey that challenges conventions.
narr: **A sensorial experience to bring the Wunderflow to life.**

Every House of Wunder bracelet features a unique Wunderflow sensation: a harmonious fusion of motion and fluidity that embraces the skin with a sensual feeling. We invite guests to discover the brand’s most distinctive signature, the Wunderflow, through an immersive art installation that transforms a unique tactile sensation into an artistic experience.
c2.scen: Guests move through a series of tactile materials (from soft velvet and delicate mesh to curtains of metallic links) experiencing the fluidity, movement and sensuality of Wunderflow against their skin.

c3.title:
BORN 
TO BE ART
c3.promise: House of Wunder invites guests to experience watches and jewellery as works of art.
narr: **For one night, House of Wunder opens an imaginary museum.**

Part art gallery, part temple, this extraordinary space celebrates watches and jewellery as works of art. Rather than being displayed behind glass, the creations come to life on sculptures: a wrist adorned with a watch, a bust draped in a necklace, a sculptural silhouette revealing a precious detail. Each creation becomes a modern relic, dramatically lit and elevated to the status of a masterpiece.
c3.scen: A field of figures, endlessly repeated. Inside a black hall, a field of plinths, statues, headless mannequins and dark monoliths, each standing alone in its own beam of light

c4.title:
THE 
ULTRAVIOLET 
CLUB
c4.promise: For one night, House of Wunder disrupts Geneva’s conventions, transforming the city’s understated elegance into something strange, sensual, and slightly unsettling.
narr: Somewhere in Geneva, an unmarked door opens onto a world unlike anything the city has seen before. Strange, sensual and slightly unsettling, this Lynchian universe invites guests to leave conventions behind. Inside, a succession of themed rooms unfolds, each revealing a new facet of House of Wunder’s universe. The final destination: an all-purple nightclub.
c4.scen: The space unfolds as a series of interconnected rooms, each revealing a different secret of House of Wunder. Guests journey through the brand’s universe, discovering its wonders one by one, before reaching the final surprise: an entirely purple nightclub.

p: • Guests step onto a beach of fine Mallorcan sand. Scenographic elements are hidden beneath the surface
• Guests dig with their hands
• They leave with a vial of the sand: a fragment of the wild, refined.
In a glowing booth, an aura reader, part mystic, part artist, captures each guest’s energy and translates it into colour, material or a matching stone.
Inspired by the traditional art of Ebru, guests explore water marbling to recreate the intricate patterns, flowing lines and vibrant colours of the House’s signature stones.

From the hypnotic green swirls of malachite to the deep blue and turquoise patterns of azurmalachite, each guest recieves a unique composition on water before transferring it onto a personalised object to take home.
A Balearic cocktail dinner signed by a chef from the island: olive oil, sobrasada, seafood, almonds and wild herbs, served on stone and ceramics by local artisans.
A structure inspired by the bracelet’s links.
Light, sound and texture ripple as you move.
An immersive dinner inside a soft, enveloping set: walls that breathe, textures you want to touch, light that moves like skin.
Each course is choreographed with projection on the walls and the pieces appear on waiter’s hands.
An immersive dinner inside a soft, enveloping set: walls that breathe, textures you want to touch, light that moves like skin.
Each course is choreographed with projection on fabrics and the pieces appear on waiter’s hands.
With HEAD – Geneve, fashion students design a capsule around the Wunderflow: fabrics that drape and move like the bracelets.
Revealed in a performance-runway, bodies in motion wearing the pieces.
A delicate silk ribbon printed with House of Wunder’s iconic watches and bracelets, translating the Wunderflow into a tactile gift.
Soft, fluid and effortless against the skin, the silk echoes the way Wunder creations glide over the body, becoming one with the wearer.
House of Wunder turns the traditional photocall into a living portrait gallery.
Set against a classical painting in an ornate golden frame, guests become part of the artwork, blurring the line between art and watchmaking.

House of Wunder creates a dialogue between art and fine watchmaking and jewellery. Set against a monumental artwork or an immersive projection, the Maison’s creations are displayed like precious relics, becoming part of the artistic composition.

House of Wunder invites guests to discover three expressions of exceptional craftsmanship. Through a dialogue between masterpieces, precious creations and exceptional wines, guests explore how time, artistry and savoir-faire transform the extraordinary into something truly unforgettable.

Throughout the night, ultraviolet light reveals a hidden layer of the experience: Invisible messages, secret menus and unexpected details on walls, objects, outfits. What was hidden suddenly becomes visible, inviting guests to look closer and uncover the secrets of the Ultraviolet Club.

The staff become part of the experience, dressed in matching deep-purple jumpsuits and elegant gloves, creating a mysterious, almost surreal presence throughout the club. Each uniform is accessorised with House of Wunder watches and jewellery, turning every interaction into a subtle opportunity to showcase the collections.

Throughout the night, the Ultraviolet Club’s identity extends to the food and drinks. Creative purple-hued cocktails and unexpected bite-sized creations play with colours, textures and flavours. A signature Ultraviolet cocktail becomes the star of the menu.

add.label: ADDITIONAL THOUGHT
add.p: This concept also offers a flexible creative framework, allowing all the other proposed themes to come to life within its different rooms.

act.intro: These activation and communication mechanics build excitement around the event and create the “worth it” factor: a reason for journalists and retailers to choose this evening over every other invitation during Watches & Wonders. They also give the brand a strong presence across the city.
signalp: Signals in the city. Mysterious visual elements appear in public space: a projection on a façade, light beams, traces on the ground, hidden QR codes. They come back at a set time or in specific places, with no explanation beyond the brand’s logo or colour. Passers-by notice them, wonder what they are and photograph them. Scanning a QR code unlocks exclusive content, such as a clue, a video or an invitation, which pulls people into the story.
roamingp: A small group of performers in recognisable outfits (purple hooded capes, logo on the back) moves through the city along a planned route. They don’t speak and don’t sell anything. They stand out through their presence, their slow pace and their ritual gestures. Now and then they interact with someone, for example by handing over an invitation or an object.
mobilep: A temporary physical space that changes location every day. It doesn’t replace the showroom or the launch evening; it sits alongside as a more intimate touchpoint. It allows closer, more personal encounters, for instance meeting the CEO in a small group or one-to-one. Access is limited: by invitation, at certain hours, or after following the clues.
oohp: Short CGI videos are set realistically in real, recognisable places such as the Jet d’eau, the harbour or a Geneva facade. They show impossible scenes like a famous statue that comes to life wearing House of Wunder pieces.

duniap: Former furniture showroom with a contemporary and industrial style, with modern and clean lines. The place benefits from a lot of natural light and high ceilings.
4 bright and modular rooms. Professional equipped kitchen.
maximep: A place in the heart of Geneva, with an elegant, hushed and contemporary atmosphere, with a chic and intimate club spirit.
Versatile and modular spaces, including a track and a bar.
vollandesp: Seventeenth-century cellars with a historic character, with vaulted rooms and stone walls. Authentic, warm and atypical setting, 400m².
appartp: Art gallery located in Les Eaux-Vives, designed as an intimate and warm space, in the spirit of an apartment rather than a traditional gallery.
hamletp: Contemporary and elegant space located in the heart of Geneva’s Old Town. The venue combines historic character with contemporary design, featuring natural materials and carefully selected furnishings.
arnop: Seventeenth-century cellars with a historic character, with vaulted rooms and stone walls. Authentic, warm and atypical setting, 400m².
calamartp: Calamart is an urban and contemporary art gallery in Geneva. It shows a constantly changing selection of artists with very different styles, all sharing the same attention to aesthetics.
